package.name: nodejs-26
package.description: JavaScript runtime built on V8 engine (Werewolf fixed hardening policy)

pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://github.com/nodejs/node.git; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" bc2e01dcf6acd5cf7d169b5f26cf89abaaeb41f1; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = bc2e01dcf6acd5cf7d169b5f26cf89abaaeb41f1
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach bc2e01dcf6acd5cf7d169b5f26cf89abaaeb41f1
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "bc2e01dcf6acd5cf7d169b5f26cf89abaaeb41f1: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

pipeline.name: Apply Werewolf policy patches
pipeline.runs:
while IFS= read -r name; do
  patch -p1 --forward --batch --fuzz=2 --no-backup-if-mismatch -i "werewolf/patches/$name" || exit 1
done < werewolf/patches/series

pipeline.name: Permit capabilities only in the build guest
pipeline.runs:
mkdir -p /etc/runtime-hardening
: > /etc/runtime-hardening/build-root
chmod 600 /etc/runtime-hardening/build-root
mkdir -p /etc/runtime-hardening/allow/all/node
for group in exec native inline writable-source environment; do
  : > /etc/runtime-hardening/allow/all/node/$group
done

pipeline.name: Configure and build
pipeline.runs:
# Add defines recommended in libuv readme.
case "${{build.arch}}" in
"aarch64")
   common_flags="-D_LARGEFILE_SOURCE -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64"
   ;;
"x86_64")
   common_flags="-D_LARGEFILE_SOURCE -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64"
   ;;
esac

# Compiling with O2 instead of Os increases binary size by ~10%
# (53.1 MiB -> 58.6 MiB), but also increases performance by ~20%
# according to v8/web-tooling-benchmark. Node.js is quite huge anyway;
# there are better options for size constrained environments.
export CFLAGS="${CFLAGS/-Os/-O2} $common_flags"
export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS/-Os/-O2} $common_flags"
export CPPFLAGS="${CPPFLAGS/-Os/-O2} $common_flags"
# NOTE: --without-corepack is no longer supported in Node.js 25+
# See: https://nodejs.org/dist/latest/docs/api/corepack.html
python${{vars.python-version}} configure.py ${{vars.configure-flags}} --without-inspector --without-npm --without-node-options --disable-single-executable-application --without-lief --without-brotli --without-zstd --without-ffi

  # Bubblewrap shows nproc every host CPU, not Melange's budget. Use half
  # of them, and keep Wolfi's memory ratio (cpu 33, memory 64Gi): one
  # compiler job per 2 GiB the host has available.
  jobs=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ { print int($2 / 2097152) }' /proc/meminfo)
  [ "$jobs" -le "$(($(nproc) / 2))" ] || jobs=$(($(nproc) / 2))
  [ "$jobs" -ge 1 ] || jobs=1
  make BUILDTYPE=Release JOBS=$jobs -j$jobs

pipeline.name: Omit package managers and documentation
pipeline.runs:
# --without-npm must actually omit npm, npx and their modules.
test ! -e "${{targets.destdir}}/usr/bin/npm"
test ! -e "${{targets.destdir}}/usr/bin/npx"
test ! -e "${{targets.destdir}}/usr/lib/node_modules/npm"
rm -R "${{targets.destdir}}/usr/share/man"

pipeline.name: Execute Basic JavaScript
pipeline.runs:
cat <<'EOF' > test.js
console.log('Hello, World!');
EOF
node test.js | grep -F 'Hello, World!'

pipeline.name: Test International Number Formatting
Werewolf protections hold, and allowances take each back
